title: Capsa link
description: A typed edge between two records (core v0.2.0, section Links). Authored in one direction only; the inverse is computed by consumers, never stored.

rel.description: Core vocabulary, or an x- prefixed private token. An unknown rel must be preserved and may be traversed.

to.description: An address: an internal path relative to the format directory, or an external @capsule-slug/path.
